titulo: The rain answered zero emails today. Still showed up.
caption:
Why a Sunday of doing nothing still counts: rain that answered no emails.

The rain answered zero emails today. Still showed up.

Closer to yourself.
alt: A short looping video in flat colors with no voice: a big tree in the rain fills the frame and the camera zooms in slowly; then it pulls back to show a window and a small round figure sitting on the sill, watching, and it smiles. White words in the middle read: "The rain answered zero emails today. Still showed up."
